current_decision: First native integration retains explicit packet prevalidation before CPU advances or marker publication. This proof gives no assumed cycle saving.
premises: Raw LOAD completes successfully with no sticky unsupported/DMA error; all used rows belong to that completed job.
Every surviving triangle has clip_or=0 and each W is positive normal and strictly below binary32 0x46fffe00 (32767).
Raw/list stay immutable until packet emission completes; used_mask is exactly the survivor-list union and live_count<=64.
App emits only flags bits0..18; textured tile origins are uint16*8 (0..524280, aligned8).
derivation: GeometryFmaProbe unsupported rejects nonfinite inputs/results and normal-mode exponents outside [-126,127]. Successful final X/Y/W outputs are finite normal or signed zero. Transform propagates every FMA/reciprocal unsupported flag to raw LOAD failure.
Successful reciprocal produces normal finite output. Its sign follows W, so a surviving positive W has positive normal inverse-W; the depth converter accepts every such value and clamps safely.
For finite values and positive W, raw clip_or=0 proves -W<=X,Y<=W. Thus abs(X,Y)<32767 and multiplication by256 cannot overflow signed32 or the converter shift bound; signed zero is accepted.

Signed16 UV minus an aligned origin in[0,524280], plus an optional16, lies within[-557048,32783]. Scaling by2048 lies within[-1140834304,67139584], safely signed32. All unscaled arithmetic is integer-exact in binary32 below2^24.

RGB packing has no arithmetic error case. Controller survivor append/union logic ensures list members and used_mask agree; this is a separate ownership/control invariant rather than a numeric guarantee.
not_proven_by_this: Arbitrary marker flags/offsets or serial/token validity.
New integrated mux/FSM/raw-store lifetime and no overwrite before packet completion.
App material/viewport/alpha/LOD correctness or CPU FCSR liveness.
Any frame-time improvement, physical fit or synthesized resource count.
